title: Four diffusion models, one small dataset

source.citation: bend-lab results/dimba: ViT vs JiT(DiT) vs HiT vs Dimba-style hybrid on flowers64

posts: Four small diffusion models, same flowers, same 1,200 training steps. On the test set, the plain transformer scored 0.514. The best hybrid scored 0.622. The difference is not the parameter count.

Here is the catch: the hybrid took 1,705 seconds; the others took about 500. Remove its Mamba blocks and the test-set score drops back to exactly the plain model's. One recurrent layer did all the work.

The full comparison, one image and every number: https://github.com/adeerkhan/bend-lab/tree/main/results/dimba 🌐 Small CPU reference models; the test set was reused for model selection, so these are validation scores.
